Why you would want it
01 ·
Direct, don't babysit.
  • Launch governed runs across many repos and projects simultaneously — one surface, not one terminal per agent.
  • Attention-decay board sorting surfaces what needs you and collapses what is quiet — signal over noise, automatically.
  • Desktop notifications when a run needs you; lifecycle controls — cancel, inject a message, retry — from the same surface.
  • Campaign grouping tracks "N of M landed" across a multi-run effort. No spreadsheet maintenance required.
02 ·
Approve what matters.
  • Human-in-the-loop gates surface the real decisions: approve, approve with a steer, or reject.
  • Gate card shows the artifact, governance findings, and the full context behind the ask — never a bare prompt.
  • Gate notification arrives within 2 seconds of the awaiting-human WebSocket event.
  • Keyboard batch triage when gates pile up across concurrent runs.
  • Pre-gate guidance notes and elicitation prompts — steer before it reaches the gate.
03 ·
"Done" is proven, not claimed.
  • The evaluator is never the creator — the check agent is independent of the coding agent.
  • Per-step transcripts, worktree file and diff viewer, and one-click evidence-bundle download for every run.
  • Full decisions ledger: every gate outcome is in the audit trail with actor, timestamp, and detail.
  • Codebase exploration with blast-radius analysis, hotspot detection, and domain graph — understand what any change touches before you approve.

From intent to pull request

How a run flows.

Every governed run moves through five phases. Studio surfaces each phase in real time over a live WebSocket feed — you are always in view, never in the dark.

01 ·
Intent
Register a repo, select a workflow — ask, balanced, or autonomous — and write the goal. The run card appears immediately; CoreEvents stream over /ws
02 ·
Council
Multiple agent seats join the run. Studio surfaces the roster — each CLI is visible. Quorum displayed as "N of N agents ready" before the first phase.
03 ·
Gates
The platform pauses at checkpoints. A gate card surfaces the artifact, governance findings, and approve · steer · reject controls. Run advances within 3 s of your decision.
04 ·
Evidence
As phases complete, the evidence panel populates: per-step transcripts, worktree diff viewer, downloadable evidence bundle, and a domain coverage report. GET /api/v1/runs/:id/evidence
05 ·
Pull Request
The deliver phase opens a PR. The URL is captured from the deliver unit's output and surfaced on the campaign card as a live link. campaign · N of M landed
Proof — evidence & acceptance gate

Every "done" leaves a retrievable record.

Decisions ledger — full audit trail
Every gate outcome is recorded with actor, timestamp, and decision detail. Browsable at /api/v1/audit  —  governance evidence endpoint at /api/v1/runs/:id/evidence.

Campaign scoreboard

Codebase exploration

One command. The API, the engine,
and the UI on a single port.

Wicked Studio is a pure HTTP/WS client of the wicked-crew daemon — zero coupling to the engine internals, no lock-in to a single agent CLI. Start governing your AI coding runs in minutes.

$ npx wicked-crew serve
